decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The parking area hereby permitted shall be removed and the land restored to its former condition on or before 6th August 2017 in accordance with a scheme of work submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted and (5109/105 rev C, 5109/101 Rev C, 5109/107 and 5109/100, received 18th January 2011 
Travel Plan, comprising the Heathland School, School Travel Plan rewrite and plan 5109/100, received 7th September 2011), therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 3 - The school will implement a car parking permit system setting out a prioritisation methodology, that will reduce demand on the car park.  the scheme shall be submitted to the Council for approval withint the first year of implementation.  The scheme should include appropriate physical restrictions for access and/or enforcement.  The permit system should seek to minimise the number of car drivers (main mode) who have reasonable alternatives to the car for accessing the site, particularly those that live within 2km of the premises.

Condition : 4 - A plan to increase car occupancy shall be developed and submitted to the council for approval within the first year of submission.  This will set out a comprehensive package of measures to promote car sharing to staff, in line with best practice laid out in this document:  https://www.liftshare.com/download/TfLCarShareGuideLOWRES.pdf .  This must include provision of sufficient (min 10%) ring-fenced car parking spaces, appropriately signed, in desirable locations for cars with 2 or more people in it.

Condition : 5 - A plan to increase car occupancy shall be developed and submitted to the council for approval within the first year of submission.  This will set out a comprehensive package of measures to promote car sharing to staff, in line with best practice laid out in this document:  https://www.liftshare.com/download/TfLCarShareGuideLOWRES.pdf .  This must include provision of sufficient (min 10%) ring-fenced car parking spaces, appropriately signed, in desirable locations for cars with 2 or more people in it.

Condition : 6 - Provision of a clear cycle entrance into the site, including signposting to appropriate visitor, staff and student cycle parking shall be provided within the first year of implementation of this scheme.

Condition : 7 - A review, via a survey, of cycle facilities for staff and students, including provision of secure parking and lockers, shall be carried out within the first year of implementation and a findings report submitted to the Council for approval.  Should this review demonstrate that additional facilities are to be provided the submitted report shall also include a commitment to increase cycle parking/lockers and/or other measures to improve facilities.

Condition : 8 - A review, via a survey, of cycle facilities for staff and students, including provision of secure parking and lockers, shall be carried out within the first year of implementation and a findings report submitted to the Council for approval.  Should this review demonstrate that additional facilities are to be provided the submitted report shall also include a commitment to increase cycle parking/lockers and/or other measures to improve facilities.
Condition : 9 - The applicant is to use best endeavours to promote the cycle salary sacrifice scheme (run by the Council) to staff biannually, as application windows are opened.

Condition : 10 - By the end of the second year of implementation the school must have developed and implemented an exemplar school travel plan, to be retained as long as the car park remains operational, achieving and maintaining 'higher standards' accreditation under the existing TfL criteria.  The criteria for this award is available from the council's school travel plan website.

Condition : 11 - No development shall take place until samples of the materials to be used in the construction of the car park and other soft landscpaing measures have been submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority.  Development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details.
description: Construction of a new permanent 40 bay car park on the site of an existing temporary car park withinin the school grounds.
